name: Samsung TV Remote
author: Ryan Doupe
description: Samsung TV remote in the bar. Arrow keys, enter and backspace to navigate. Keys 1-9 launch the apps your TV has: YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video. Hold a key to repeat like the real remote. Volume with live readout. Wake-on-LAN turns the TV on and reopens what you were watching. Finds your TV itself, no IP to enter. Bindable to a hotkey. Samsung Tizen 2016+. Python 3 only.

barWidget.description: Arrow keys, enter and backspace drive the TV, 1-9 launch its apps. Volume, hold-to-repeat, wake-on-LAN. Finds your Samsung TV itself.
